task.description:
Write test spec file at tests/specs/DSL-09.md covering:

1. now() returns platform's current time (value > 1_000_000_000_000 ms since epoch)
2. date_add(ts, n, unit) with each supported unit: second, minute, hour, day
3. date_diff(ts1, ts2, unit) with each supported unit: second, minute, hour, day
4. Null propagation: any null argument returns null
5. Unknown unit returns evaluation error
6. Cross-DST boundary test: timestamp just before US DST spring-forward (e.g. 2026-03-08T01:59:00Z) + 1 day = +86400000ms exactly (pure UTC arithmetic)
7. Negative n values for date_add
8. Negative diff for date_diff (ts1 < ts2)
9. Wrong argument count returns evaluation error
10. Overflow handling (extreme values)

Format: per the test guide — standard Gherkin-style Given/When/Then for each test case.

The test implementation (Zig test code) is handled by BACKEND-DEV in src/expr/mod.zig. This spec is the human-readable test specification.
acceptance_criteria: Covers all 10 test categories listed above
Format follows test developer guide conventions
